name: medical-s2-evidence-mini
description: Retrieve bounded evidence only from host-approved, versioned medical-research sources and preserve traceable limitations.
---

# Evidence retrieval

1. State the question and evidence need before selecting an approved source
   identifier.
2. Retrieve only through named host tools and retain the returned source or
   revision identifier with the observed claim.
3. Separate source statements, analytic inferences, and unresolved gaps.
4. Do not invent citations, use unauthorised live sources, or transform a
   bounded passage into patient-specific clinical advice.
